paragraphs: Interactive demo of SupraLabs/SupraElegans-500k: a 574K-parameter causal language model that has no attention, no positional encoding and no KV cache. Instead of a Transformer it uses a sparse, signed, recurrent neural graph loosely inspired by the C. elegans nervous system — 900 neurons (135 sensory → 630 interneurons → 135 output) wired by 12,769 directed excitatory/inhibitory edges. Context is carried entirely by a persistent per-neuron membrane potential:
The Space generates a completion and records the state of all 900 neurons at every token, so you can scrub through the network step by step:
with the running text and the output neurons' next-token distribution at that step.
